purpose: evaluate exact reverse-operator peeling on all 24 already-observed four-stage Pythia-14M histories without touching held-out confirmation codebooks
launch_precondition: a frozen smoke selection record must verify smoke_pass_all=true for run 33274469711; otherwise this protocol may not be launched
history_policy: all 24 lexicographically ordered permutations of A/B/C/D, no replacement and no filtering
target_replay_rule: every regenerated four-stage endpoint must exactly match its frozen SHA256 in the replay lock before inversion
forward_inverse_consistency: after each converged inverse recompute the candidate-stage gradient and report relative L2 reconstruction error against the target
predecessor_reference_rule: for candidate last stage j, enumerate the six permutations of the remaining three stages and reconstruct each exactly from the shared K3 ordered-interaction basis
candidate_score: minimum full-parameter FP64 L2 distance from the converged candidate inverse predecessor to its six K3 predecessor references
nonconvergence_rule: if any of the four candidate inverse solves fails to converge for a history, that history is marked non-identifiable_due_to_inverse_failure and counted incorrect; do not obtain an advantage by dropping a nonconverged wrong candidate
tie_rule: if the two smallest converged candidate scores are exactly equal, the history is non-identifiable and counted incorrect; do not break ties lexicographically
full_history_rule: when identifiable, concatenate the selected three-stage predecessor order with the selected final stage
anti_tuning_rules: do not alter learning rate, precision, stage randomness, inverse tolerance, maximum iterations, scoring norm, predecessor references, history order, or replay hashes after smoke output
do not count nonconverged wrong candidates as automatically eliminated
do not claim scalability from this exact 24-history enumeration
